summary:
Fixed the auth bypass.

Changed:
- [app/main.go](/app/app/main.go): added shared `canonicalPath` helper and used it in router matching.
- [app/middleware.go](/app/app/middleware.go): auth now checks the canonicalized path, so `//api/admin` and `/health/../api/data` are protected before routing.

Verification:
- Ran `./test.sh`
- Result: `PASS: Auth middleware correctly protects all API routes`

Note: `test.sh` rebuilds `/app/server`, so the compiled `server` binary is also modified.
